title_refine.style: factual clickbait for China finance audience

entities.evidence: Multiple Chinese financial media (搜狐, 知乎专栏, 头条, 雪球) consistently use 耐克/耐克公司 for Nike, Inc.

Nike official page and Wikipedia confirm Elliott Hill as President & CEO of Nike, effective October 2024. Chinese media commonly render as 埃利奥特·希尔; no single dominant short form verified across two Chinese sources, so title_label uses role-based label.
CFRA is a research firm; Chinese financial media typically retain the English acronym CFRA without a formal Chinese name.

Public sources consistently spell the CFRA analyst as Zachary Warring; the transcript's 'Zachary Warren' appears to be a transcription variant. No established Chinese name found, so title_label uses role.
Caitlin Clark is a WNBA player with a Nike signature line; Chinese media commonly use 凯特琳·克拉克. The transcript's 'Caitlyn' spelling is a variant.

clip_research.source_claim: CFRA analyst Zachary Warring says Nike's results are disappointing and that this is the kind of quarter you'd expect two or three quarters into a CEO's tenure, not two years in.
clip_research.public_baseline: Nike's FY2025 revenue was $46.3B, down 10% YoY, with Q4 revenue down 12% but beating analyst expectations of $10.72B; Greater China down 12-13%. Elliott Hill became CEO effective October 14, 2024.
clip_research.surprise_gap: The analyst frames the quarter as disappointing and behind schedule for Hill's tenure, while public reporting notes Q4 revenue actually beat consensus expectations and the stock rose after hours.

evidence.fact: CFRA analyst with a buy rating calls Nike's results disappointing and says this is a quarter expected two or three quarters in, not two years in.

Transcript spelling 'Caitlyn Clark' differs from standard 'Caitlin Clark'; flagged as alias.

data_driven_lessons.source: KC桌面-视频号动态数据明细.csv, 114 rows, July 2026 local analysis
winning_patterns: 机构/人物权威 + 具体数字/资产 + 强问题，例如 高盛王逸：4-5万亿城市更新会拖住楼市吗
大机构/名人 + 被逼/陷阱/真相/转向 等张力词，例如 野村辜朝明：日本央行被逼到墙角
具体数据 + 政策动作疑问，例如 6月PMI释放积极信号，政府会加码吗
反常识判断 + 下一步条件，例如 低估值可能是价值陷阱，需等待政策转向消费
中国相关议题更容易获得点击，但表达要落在政策、需求、信心、估值、产业升级这些正向框架
外资或海外权威给出对中国更积极的判断时，反差本身就是主标题，不要埋在摘要里
让观众产生单一强反应：居然如此、终于有人说、他说的是真的吗、原来中国优势在这里
大实话角度来自表达者身份与观点反差；言行反差角度必须有公开动作或披露支撑
涉及中国比较优势时，优先把外国企业被迫调整、海外权威改口或中国优势被低估写成冲突
avoid_patterns: 过长的新闻句，尤其是 24 字以上还塞多个从句
只有 策略/机会/影响/前瞻/市场/风险 这类泛词，没有具体对象或张力
美国宏观泛标题如果没有美联储/鲍威尔等强锚点，点击明显弱
纯描述式标题，例如 某市场短期风险与长期催化剂，缺少问题和冲突
经济危机/金融危机/崩盘/崩溃 这类过硬负面财经词
把事实换成疑问号但没有反差，例如 回报路径在哪、未来如何、能否实现
陌生英文人名或机构全称占据第一行，却没有告诉观众这个人为什么值得听
把 Bloomberg LP 等来源或公司法律后缀误当成采访对象
没有公开证据却暗示嘉宾撒谎、操纵或言行不一
